_comment: Canonical gfx942 (CDNA3 / MI300X) SDPA-fwd shapes exercised by the
ck_dsl unified-attention 2D tiled kernel. These mirror exactly the set
validated by the ck-dsl-provider integration tests
(dnn-providers/ck-dsl-provider/integration_tests/IntegrationGpuCkDslSdpaFwdFp16.cpp)
plus the perf shapes from the gfx942 case study
(dsl_docs/architecture/attention_2d_gfx942_experiment_summary.md).
Every case is causal (the unified paged kernel is causal-only). GQA is
expressed via kv_heads < heads (heads % kv_heads == 0). head_size in
{64,128}; head_size=256 is unsupported on gfx942 (exceeds the 64 KB LDS
budget) so it is intentionally absent. The harness maps each dense
[batch, heads, seqlen, head_size] SDPA problem onto the kernel's paged
layout with block_size=64.
Schema per shape:
name        : stable identifier
dtype       : fp16 | bf16
seqlen_q    : query sequence length per batch element
seqlen_k    : key/value sequence length per batch element
head_size   : D (per-head dimension)
heads       : Hq (query heads)
kv_heads    : Hkv (key/value heads; GQA when < heads)
batch       : B (number of independent sequences)
causal      : true for all gfx942 SDPA-fwd cases
group       : correctness | perf  (which scenario set the shape belongs to)
